title: Crispy Vietnamese Spring Rolls
description: A delicious and crunchy snack made with crispy spring rolls, andouille sausage, and vietnamese ingredients. Serve with a side of sweet chili sauce.

ingredients.name: Crispy spring rolls
ingredients.notes: Found in most Asian markets or online

ingredients.name: Vietnamese roll filling (or alternative of choice)
ingredients.notes: Typically includes carrots, cucumbers, mint, and basil

instructions: 1. Cook the kombu noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
2. Slice the andouille sausage into thin rounds.
3. Prepare the roll filling according to the package instructions or your own recipe.
4. Fill each spring roll with a few slices of sausage, some roll filling, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
5. Serve the spring rolls with a side of sweet chili sauce for dipping.
6. Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
